**Finding: Compliant** (rule LD — Liquidated damages and penalties payable by Customer)

No clause in the agreement requires Juniper Ridge to pay liquidated damages, a penalty, an early-termination fee, or a minimum charge on termination:

- **§ 27.3** — Customer may terminate the affected Order Form **"without penalty"** and receive a refund of prepaid Fees.
- **§ 7.3** — Vendor may not charge interest on amounts ultimately found not due.
- **§ 24.4** — Customer change of control gives Vendor no right to reprice or accelerate Fees.
- **§§ 8–10** — Termination provisions contain no exit fee or wind-down charge.

This sits at the **preferred position**, so no redline was proposed.

Two contextual notes (not deviations under this rule): the § 2.1 take-or-pay commitment (USD 2,000,000/year, "without reduction or termination rights") is the closest economic analogue to a Customer-payable minimum, but it is a purchase commitment rather than an LD mechanic and belongs under the minimum-commitment rule — flagging it here would double-count the same commercial term. Also, the body contains no service-credit regime; credits are left to the service-level exhibit referenced in § 2.2, which is worth confirming separately.
